title: Code for: Same protein targets, different association patterns: a paired three-assay study of CSF protein associations with p-tau and longitudinal cognitive change across the Alzheimer’s disease spectrum
description: Analysis and visualization code for paired ADNI CSF NULISA, SomaScan and TMT-MS associations with p-tau181 and longitudinal cognitive change. Includes frozen workflows, reusable numerical kernels, aggregate figure inputs and a synthetic-data example. Participant-level ADNI data are not included.
